description: This PHP source file defines the class EventBridgeEndpointMiddleware, which handles the rerouting of EventBridge requests to appropriate endpoints within the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes methods for wrapping handlers, validating endpoint IDs, and constructing request URIs based on configuration and region.

classes.name: EventBridgeEndpointMiddleware

methods.description: Constructor initializing the middleware with handler, region, config, endpoint provider, and custom endpoint flag.

methods.description: Invokes the middleware, potentially modifying the request URI based on the command parameters and endpoint provider.
